ideas.title: Following the Money in Medicaid Fraud
ideas.description: This story would investigate the flow of money in Medicaid fraud cases, including the Feeding Our Future fraud case and the Hortonville woman's alleged $58,000 FoodShare, child care fraud.
questions: How much money is being stolen through Medicaid fraud?
What can be done to prevent it?
ideas.insight: This story idea is significant because it would provide a deeper understanding of the scope and complexity of Medicaid fraud, and could lead to further investigations and arrests.
